device.description: 5-V 12-bit 400-kSPS 8-channel serial ADC with 8x FIFO, CFR configuration register, CSTART and auto power down
device.note: tlc2554.pdf (SLAS220A) p.1 pinouts, p.3-4 terminal functions, p.5-6 serial interface and data formats, p.6 Table 1 command set, p.7 Table 2 CFR, p.8-9 conversion modes (Table 3), p.10-17 timing diagrams, p.18-19 FIFO, conversion speed, power down, p.19-20 recommended operating conditions and timing

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: Table 2 (p.7): configuration register, written with A000h plus data and read with 9000h; power-up value not given (0 here; the datasheet requires writing A000h at power up)

commands.name: Select analog input channel (short, 12 SCLK sampling)
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): 0000b-0111b = channels 0-7; the conversion starts after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th (long sampling) SCLK edge (p.8)

commands.name: Select analog input channel (long, 24 SCLK sampling)
commands.note: Table 1 (p.6): 0000b-0111b = channels 0-7; the conversion starts after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th (long sampling) SCLK edge (p.8)

commands.name: SW power down
commands.note: Table 1: 8000h powers down analog + reference; modeled as a nop (p.19: 20 ms to resume, FIFO cleared)

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.5/p.10: the first 4 SDO bits are don't care, the CFR content is in the last 12 bits

commands.name: Select test, voltage = (REFP+REFM)/2
commands.note: Table 1 / p.22 self-test codes (800h/000h/FFFh); modeled as a conversion returning the 0 V code

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFM
commands.note: Table 1 / p.22 self-test codes (800h/000h/FFFh); modeled as a conversion returning the 0 V code

commands.name: Select test, voltage = REFP
commands.note: Table 1 / p.22 self-test codes (800h/000h/FFFh); modeled as a conversion returning the 0 V code

commands.name: FIFO read
commands.note: Table 1: FIFO contents shown as SDO D15-D4, D3-D0 = 0000 (the output frame of every conversion/FIFO read cycle)

ready.note: CFR.D2 = 1: EOC, low from the end of sampling until the conversion is complete (mode 00 only)
CFR.D2 = 0: INT, falls when data are ready, cleared by the following CS falling edge (td(CSL-INTH))

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5-6 (data formats, start of cycle, Table 1), p.7 (Table 2 CFR), p.8-9 (sampling, conversion modes, Table 3), p.10-17 (timing diagrams), p.18 (FIFO, conversion speed), p.19 (power down, initialization, ROC), p.20 (timing: td(CLK-DOV) 25 ns, td(CSH-DOZ) 25 ns, td(SCLK-INTL) 3.5 us), p.22 (tconv = 14 x DIV / fSCLK)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal 4-V reference / external reference (CFR.D11), pseudo-differential input (CFR.D7: A2 is the minus input): every conversion returns the 0 V code; 2's complement output (CFR.D10 = 1) puts REFM = 0 V at 800h, modeled as codeFormat offset
self-test commands B000h/C000h/D000h output 800h/000h/FFFh; modeled as conversions returning the 0 V code

8-level FIFO and conversion modes 01 (repeat), 10 (sweep), 11 (repeat sweep) with the sweep sequences (CFR.D4-D3) and FIFO trigger levels (CFR.D1-D0): every conversion is treated as one-shot (mode 00); INT asserts after each conversion, not at the FIFO threshold, and in modes 01-11 the pin is INT regardless of CFR.D2 (not modeled: it follows CFR.D2)
FS (DSP frame sync) mode: input on SCLK falling edges, output on rising edges, FS-started frames; only FS = 1 (CS-framed SPI) is modeled
conversion time: clocked by SCLK (14 x DIV / fSCLK plus 4 SCLKs, CFR.D8 divider); modeled as 3.5 us (td(SCLK-INTL)/td(CSTARTH-INTL) maximum, 16th SCLK or CSTART rising to INT falling)
SW power down (8000h): modeled as a nop; 20 ms resume, FIFO cleared, auto power down

CSTART extended sampling: sampling from CSTART falling, conversion at CSTART rising (modeled as the convst edge); select commands with CSTART-triggered conversions still start a conversion at the 16th SCLK here
power-up initialization write A000h (host select mode); the first conversion after power up is invalid
reserved command 1111b and the TLC2554 N/A odd channel codes: ignored
result pipelining: SDO carries the previous conversion result; the result is constant
variants: TLC2554 (4 channels, 16-pin D/PW) and TLC2558 (8 channels, 20-pin DW/PW) share this datasheet; the TLC2554 decodes channel codes 0000b/0010b/0100b/0110b as A0-A3.
